notes.title: To celebrate the release of the demo, I've created a magical art contest!
notes.notes:
Good News everyone!

The demo "There's No Dinosaurs 2" have been released today  

You can find it here:


Steam page[Full release on Steam 20 June & 13 June Nintendo Switch] 


To celebrate the release, I've created a magical art contest!

Hey, gamer   Let's be creative! 

Art contest giveaway 

Create and submit images with Dino from "There's No Dinosaurs 2" [ a cozy game with hidden objects and retro vibes]

Submit images in the  ⁠⁠qa  channel Discord

User-created images only (No AI generation. AI competition will be held individually at a later date)
 
Spoiler alert: On Dino 2, there are multiple levels, you can be inspired if you play the demo. 

This contest will end on 15 June [ 1 week of submission + rest of community vote]

Giveaway $20 Steam Gift Card to the winner

everyone is welcome to participate, if you want, don't worry about your talent
